title: Field-valued SL2 is generated by commutators away from the small fields
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $a\in F$ satisfy $a\ne0$ and $a^2\ne1$. Write $\operatorname{SL}_2(F)$ for the abstract group of $2\times2$ matrices over $F$ with determinant one, under matrix multiplication. Then $$[\operatorname{SL}_2(F),\operatorname{SL}_2(F)]=\operatorname{SL}_2(F),$$ where the left hand side is the subgroup generated by all commutators $xyx^{-1}y^{-1}$.

source.place: Proposition 20.24, printed p.416, its elementary-matrix commutator calculation with an element whose square differs from one. The actual abstract-group statement is in Mathlib.
